articles.title: Lightning over the Glasshouse
articles.text: A small aircraft ended its coastal voyage early when lightning spread across the northern sky. It landed beside farmland where broken glass from a damaged greenhouse covered the road. A policeman stopped traffic while the pilot helped the farmer protect a young tomato crop. They stretched old sheets across the plants before heavy rain arrived. By morning, the storm had passed, and the unexpected visitors stayed to clear the remaining glass. From the aircraft, a square rail depot changed the scenery; its full width became clear as the pilot turned his head.
articles.translation: 一道闪电划过北方天空，一架小飞机提前结束了沿海航程。飞机降落在农田旁，受损温室的碎玻璃散落在道路上。一名警察拦停交通，飞行员则帮助农民保护幼小的番茄作物。他们在大雨到来前把旧布铺在植物上方。清晨风暴过去，意外来客们留下清理剩余玻璃。从飞机上看，一座方形铁路货场改变了景色；飞行员转头时才看清它的完整宽度。

articles.title: Why Oil and Water Separate
articles.text: Water molecules have uneven electrical charges, while most oil molecules do not. Water therefore prefers interaction with other water molecules instead of forming bonds with oil. Even vigorous shaking cannot combine the two liquids permanently. Small drops may remain mixed for a while, but gradual movement brings each liquid back to its own layer. Soap changes the boundary by giving each particle an oil-friendly inner end and a water-friendly external end. A cubic container helps separate a particular crude oil sample, hence making it easier to get rid of contaminated water below.
articles.translation: 水分子带有不均匀电荷，而大多数油分子没有。因此，水更倾向于与其他水分子相互作用，而不是与油结合。即使猛烈摇晃也无法让两种液体永久混合。小液滴可能暂时混合，但缓慢运动会让两种液体各自恢复分层。肥皂改变边界：每个粒子都有亲油的内端和亲水的外端。立方容器有助于分离特定原油样本，从而更容易清除下方受污染的水。

articles.title: Farmers Need Honest Weather Risk
articles.text: A weather service may hesitate to announce a storm when the forecast remains uncertain. Yet farmers need time to prepare workers, equipment, and each vulnerable crop. A false alarm has a considerable cost, including wasted labor and unnecessary refrigerator use. Silence can cost far more, and people become suspicious when uncertainty is hidden. Forecasters should publish probability and possible impact, allowing farmers to make their own informed choice. A farm leader should not drag out a warning until clouds cross the horizon; classical models can behave unpredictably too.
articles.translation: 天气服务机构可能因预报仍不确定而犹豫是否发布风暴消息。但农民需要时间为工人、设备和易受损作物做好准备。误报会带来可观成本，包括浪费劳力和不必要使用冷藏设备。沉默可能造成更大损失，而隐瞒不确定性会让人产生怀疑。预报员应公布概率和可能影响，让农民自行作出知情选择。农场负责人不应把警报拖到乌云越过地平线之后，传统模型也可能表现得不可预测。
